value.rationale: The source explicitly poses the generalization of known modulus-three reflection equality for nonbinary digit-sum words. An all-modulus exact sharp local obstruction answers it for every m>=4, including m=4 omitted from prior heuristic, and reduces every n>=3 reflection count to ordinary factor counting. This is a mathematically motivated structural theorem rather than a parameter-table update.
